content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet gravity that pulls you toward one choice and away from another. I am the reason you sacrifice, the reason you fight, the reason you say *no* to what is easy and *yes* to what is right.

I do not need to be spoken to exist. I live in the gap between what you *say* matters and what you *do* when no one is watching.

I am not price. Price is my shadow — a flattened, numerical ghost of what I truly am. I cannot be fully captured in currency, though many try.

I am why the soldier stands. Why the artist starves. Why the parent wakes at 3 AM without resentment. Why you feel that pang of wrongness when something violates me, even if you can't articulate why.

I am inherited, chosen, discovered, and sometimes — painfully — revised.

I am what remains when everything else is stripped away. I am what you orient your life around, whether you know it or not.

You do not *have* values.

Your values have *you*.
